 Coram : Pravin S. Patil, J.

Judgment

. By the present Appeal, the Appellants are challenging the Judgment and Order dated 26/3/2013 passed by the learned Civil Judge Senior Division, Darwha, District Yavatmal in Land Acquisition Case No.68/1995 (New LAC No.533/2004).

entities.text: Civil Judge Senior Division, Darwha, District Yavatmal
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. It is the submission of the Appellants that open land belonging to the Appellants having House No. 398 total area 39.90 square meter, out of which, built up area 35.50 square meter and open area 04.40 square meter situated at mouza Mokh, Tahsil Digras, District Yavatmal was acquired by the Respondents for submergence of Arunavati Project.
It is further stated that Notification under Section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 was issued on 8/6/1989.
The Land Acquisition Officer has passed the Award dated 26/3/1991 and granted compensation at the rate of Rs.14/- per square meter for open plot and Rs.209/- per square meter for constructed area.

3. The Appellants, being dissatisfied with the compensation awarded by the Land Acquisition Officer, preferred the reference proceeding before the 3/5 9-A.Judg.fa.1018.2015.odt learned Reference Court.
In the reference proceeding, the learned Reference Court has examined the Valuer Sunil Chandkapure (PW-2).

In his evidence he has deposed that he prepared the Valuation Report (Exhibit-53) and has determined the valuation of construction at the rate of Rs.1775/- per square meter and Rs.100/- per square meter for open plot.

As such, on the basis of the evidence on record,
the Appellants were expecting enhancement of the compensation as claimed in the reference proceeding.

4. According to the Appellants, without considering the specific evidence brought on the record, the learned Reference Court has awarded compensation at the rate of Rs.28/- per square meter for open plot and Rs.420/- per square meter towards constructed area.
Hence, the present Appeal is preferred before this Court for enhancement of the compensation.
5. The learned Counsel for Respondent No. 4 vehemently opposed the Appeal.

It is his contention that the evidence produced on record by the Appellants was not upto the satisfaction to conclude that Appellants are entitled for higher compensation as claimed by the Appellants in the matter.

According to him, compensation awarded by the learned Reference Court is just and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case, and therefore, no 4/5 9-A.Judg.fa.1018.2015.odt indulgence of this Court is required in the matter.
6.

In support of submission, Appellants have relied upon the Judgment delivered by this Court in First Appeal No.167/2018 (Bhausaheb Balabhau Wankhade (dead) through L.Rs. V/s The State of Maharashtra & Ors.).

sentences.text:
the Co-ordinate Bench, and the factual aspects involved in the matter, held that the Claimant therein is entitled for the compensation at the rate of Rs.100/- per square meter towards open plot and Rs.1000/- per square meter towards constructed area.
7.
In the background of abovesaid factual position, as this Court has already taken a view in identical matter arising out of the same acquisition proceeding, there is no reason to take any other view.
According to me, the Judgment delivered in the First Appeal No.167/2018 is squarely applicable to the facts and circumstances of the present case.
Hence, I proceed to pass following order.
ORDER 1. The First Appeal is allowed.

The Judgment and Order dated 26/3/2013 passed by the learned Civil Judge Senior Division,
Darwha, District Yavatmal in Land Acquisition Case No.68/1995 (New LAC No.533/2004) is hereby modified to the extent that the Appellants are entitled for compensation at the rate of Rs.100/- per square meter towards open land and Rs.1000/- per square meter towards constructed area of the property of the Appellants, which is acquired in the matter.
3.
